judgments.subject: structure.sections.app-server-native-operation
judgments.conclusion: The canonical Review Bench skill owns the App Server-native model-facing instruction to use the host-mediated evaluation interface, leave deterministic mechanics to the stateless service, and preserve the causal separation between experimental evidence and production authority; generated structure and interface artifacts bind and project that doctrine without becoming independent policy owners.

judgments.subject: interface.boundaries.evidence.descriptive-only
judgments.conclusion: The App Server Review Bench service owns closed artifact validation, pure blinded rendering, supplied-observation inventory classification, and descriptive comparison; immutable artifact owners retain corpus, truth, results, scoring, and snapshot state.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.modes
judgments.conclusion: Review Bench is compiled below core and exposed only through a generation-local host-mediated adapter; executable-generation machinery remains the sole attachment lifecycle owner.

judgments.subject: interface.boundaries.authority.no-production-approval
judgments.conclusion: Validation and comparison outputs remain experimental descriptive evidence and cannot admit a reviewer profile, route production review, accept a reviewed slice, or establish model independence.
